params.description: Asset ID for any asset on X-Chain

params.name: addresses
params.description: A comma separated list of X-Chain or P-Chain wallet addresses, starting with "avax"/"fuji", "P-avax"/"P-fuji" or "X-avax"/"X-fuji".

params.name: network
params.description: Either mainnet or testnet/fuji.

items.docs: Returns Primary Network chains that each address has touched in the form of an address mapped array. If an address has had any on-chain interaction for a chain, that chain's chain id will be returned.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A page token, received from a previous list call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. The minimum page size is 1. The maximum pageSize is 100.

params.name: network
params.description: Either mainnet or testnet/fuji.

params.name: nodeIds
params.description: A comma separated list of node ids to filter by. Supports substring matching.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
Which property to sort by, in conjunction with sortOrder.

Note: Delegation fee is only available for mainnet validators. Set `subnetId` to `11111111111111111111111111111111LpoYY`  to use this option.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The order by which to sort results. Use "asc" for ascending order, "desc" for descending order. Sorted by timestamp or the `sortBy` query parameter, if provided.

params.name: validationStatus
params.description: Validation status of the node.

params.name: minDelegationCapacity
params.description: The minimum delegation capacity, in nAVAX, used to filter the set of nodes being returned. Accepts values between 0 and 720,000,000,000,000,000

params.name: maxDelegationCapacity
params.description: The maximum delegation capacity, in nAVAX, used to filter the set of nodes being returned. Accepts values between 0 and 720,000,000,000,000,000.

params.name: minTimeRemaining
params.description: The minimum validation time remaining, in seconds, used to filter the set of nodes being returned.

params.name: maxTimeRemaining
params.description: The maximum validation time remaining, in seconds, used to filter the set of nodes being returned.

params.name: minFeePercentage
params.description: The minimum fee percentage, used to filter the set of nodes being returned. If this field is populated no subnet validations will be returned, as their fee percentage is null, since subnet delegations are not supported. Default is 2.0, as per the Avalanche spec.

params.name: maxFeePercentage
params.description: The maximum fee percentage, used to filter the set of nodes being returned. If this field is populated no subnet validations will be returned, as their fee percentage is null, since subnet delegations are not supported. Default is 100.0.

params.name: minUptimePerformance
params.description: The minimum node uptime performance percentage, which represents node health, used to filter the set of nodes being returned Default is 90.

params.name: maxUptimePerformance
params.description: The maximum node uptime performance percentage, which represents node health, used to filter the set of nodes being returned. Default is 100.

params.name: subnetId
params.description: The subnet ID to filter by. If not provided, then all subnets will be returned.

items.docs: Lists details for validators. By default, returns details for all validators.  The nodeIds parameter supports substring matching. Filterable by validation status, delegation capacity, time remaining, fee percentage, uptime performance, and subnet id.
